author: Ari Koslow
title: Tyrese Haliburton (Achilles) says he can 'do everything'
desc: Tyrese Haliburton told reporters that he is "able to do everything."
impact: Haliburton did not play at all last season. It appeared he had a chance to return late in the year until he had a case of shingles in February. He appears well on his way to be back to being to full strength for the start of next season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Alijah Martin tendered by Raptors
desc: The Raptors tendered a two-way qualifying offer to Alijah Martin.
impact: Martin is set to become a restricted free agent.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Buddy Hield pushes back guaranteed deadline date on contract
desc: The Hawks and Buddy Hield have agreed to push back the guaranteed deadline date on his contract.
impact: The move allows both sides to have more time to flush out options. The original deadline date was last Thursday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bogdan Bogdanovic pushes option date back to June 29 with Clippers
desc: The Clippers and Bogdan Bogdanović have agreed to push back his option date to June 29.
impact: Los Angeles is continuing trade conversations for Bogdanović.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Yaxel Lendeborg (ankle/knee) expected to play in Summer League
desc: Yaxel Lendeborg said he does plan to play in summer league.
impact: Lendeborg suffered an ankle sprain and left knee bone bruise in Michigan's title run. He clarified that he is now fully healthy.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tamar Bates signs two-way deal with Jazz
desc: The Utah Jazz plan to sign Tamar Bates to a two-way deal.
impact: Bates was sidelined with a foot injury as a two-way rookie for the Nuggets last season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jahmir Young has team option declined by Heat
desc: The Miami Heat declined the $2.41 million team option on Jahmir Young.
impact: Young made All-NBA G League Second Team last season, averaging 25.9 points, 8.5 assists, 4.9 rebounds, and 1.8 steals. He has appeared in 20 NBA games the past two seasons.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dereck Lively II (foot) not cleared to run
desc: Dereck Lively II has not yet been cleared to run.
impact: Lively is no longer in a boot following his season-ending surgery last year. He has resumed walking, just not running yet. "I'm taking even more time than I need to make sure I don't ever have to deal with this foot again," he said.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Lachlan Olbrich to play for Warriors in Summer League
desc: Lachlan Olbrich will play for the Golden State Warriors in the 2026 NBA Summer League.
impact: Olbrich was with the Bulls last season as a two-way player. He'll look to prove himself further with the Warriors Summer League team.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Lonnie Walker IV could return to NBA
desc: Lonnie Walker IV is a candidate to return to the NBA next season.
impact: Walker played in the EuroLeague last season. He has an NBA out in his Maccabi Tel Aviv contract until July 15.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Isaiah Crawford tendered by Rockets
desc: The Rockets have tendered a two-way qualifying offer to Isaiah Crawford.
impact: Crawford will now be a restricted free agent this summer. He is likely to remain off the fantasy radar.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Chaney Johnson tendered by Nets
desc: The Nets have tendered a two-way qualifying offer to Chaney Johnson.
impact: Johnson will now be a restricted free agent this summer. He is likely to remain off the fantasy radar.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Rui Hachimura linked to Nets, Spurs
desc: Rui Hachimura is expected to draw interest from the Nets and Spurs in free agency this offseason.
impact: Hachimura figures to be one of the more highly sought after players when free agency begins. His fantasy value will be dependent on the situation he is entering.
